rows.s_sql:
SET @prov_c := '%s';
SET	@id := '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET	@send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);
SET	@b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET @start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_labor1519(
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) NOT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) NOT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
  target int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  result10 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	result11 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	result12 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	result1 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	result2 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	result3 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	result4 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	result5 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	result6 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	result7 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	result8 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	result9 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_labor1519 WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);
INSERT IGNORE INTO s_labor1519
(
SELECT @id,p.check_hosp HOSPCODE,concat(h.provcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.distcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.subdistcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) as areacode
,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as d_com,@b_year+543
,COUNT(DISTINCT p.cid) traget
,SUM(IF(l.m in(10) ,l.lborn,0)) r10
,SUM(IF(l.m in(11) ,l.lborn,0)) r11
,SUM(IF(l.m in(12) ,l.lborn,0)) r12
,SUM(IF(l.m in(1) ,l.lborn,0)) r1
,SUM(IF(l.m in(2) ,l.lborn,0)) r2
,SUM(IF(l.m in(3) ,l.lborn,0)) r3
,SUM(IF(l.m in(4) ,l.lborn,0)) r4
,SUM(IF(l.m in(5) ,l.lborn,0)) r5
,SUM(IF(l.m in(6) ,l.lborn,0)) r6
,SUM(IF(l.m in(7) ,l.lborn,0)) r7
,SUM(IF(l.m in(8) ,l.lborn,0)) r8
,SUM(IF(l.m in(9) ,l.lborn,0)) r9
FROM
t_person_cid p
INNER JOIN chospital h ON p.check_hosp=h.hoscode
LEFT JOIN (
	SELECT cid,bdate,DATE_FORMAT(BDATE,'%m') m,sum(LBORN) LBORN
	FROM t_labor
	WHERE TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR,birth,BDATE) BETWEEN 15 and 19 AND BDATE BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d			 AND LBORN >=1
	GROUP BY cid
)  l ON  l.cid=p.CID
WHERE	p.age_y BETWEEN 15 AND 19 	AND p.sex IN(2)
AND p.check_typearea in(1,3) AND p.DISCHARGE in(9) AND h.provcode=@prov_c 
GROUP BY p.check_hosp
);
rows.aname: จำนวนการคลอดมีชีพโดยหญิงอายุ 15 - 19 ปี (จากแฟ้ม Labor) ดูข้อมูลจากจำนวนเด็กเกิดมีชีพ  (LBORN)

zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code ,h.zone_name as a_name, SUM("target") as "target" ,SUM("result10"+"result11"+"result12"+"result1"+"result2"+"result3"+"result4"+"result5"+"result6"+"result7"+"result8"+"result9") as "result" ,SUM("result10") as "result10" ,SUM("result11") as "result11" ,SUM("result12") as "result12" ,SUM("result1") as "result1" ,SUM("result2") as "result2" ,SUM("result3") as "result3" ,SUM("result4") as "result4" ,SUM("result5") as "result5" ,SUM("result6") as "result6" ,SUM("result7") as "result7" ,SUM("result8") as "result8" ,SUM("result9") as "result9"  FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY h.zone_code,h.zone_name ORDER BY h.zone_code
